notes.title: Update 5.03.00
notes.notes:
Good day, commanders! We have an update!

What's new:
• New functionality "Supply"
• New consumables "Smoke Generator" and "Sonar"
• Increased slots for Attack and Defense upgrades from 2 to 3
• Optional choice of starting shells at the beginning of the battle
• New ship Gneisenau
• New special offers in the store
• Combat voice acting
• Dynamic camera
• General bug fixes and interface improvements

notes.title: Update 5.02.06
notes.notes:
Hello, Commander! The new update is already here!
* Meet the Navy's newest warships
* New types of weapons

Enjoy the update and have a good day!
There are a lot of new things ahead!
